subject: Mythology
title: Holi: The Festival of Colors
description: A short lesson to help you apply Holi: The Festival of Colors.

hook.text: During Holi, millions of people throw colored powder at each other, turning streets into living rainbows.

buildup.text: It celebrates the love story of Krishna and Radha. Krishna playfully smeared color on Radha's face.

discovery.text: It also marks the triumph of good over evil: the demoness Holika tried to burn a boy alive but burned herself instead.

twist.text: During Holi, social barriers dissolve. Rich and poor, young and old throw colors at each other as complete equals.

climax.text: The festival has spread globally, inspiring color runs and celebrations on every continent.

punchline.text: A god's prank became a festival that erases all human boundaries.

quiz.question: Which mythological love story is associated with Holi?
